gameName: This War of Mine: The Board Game

provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: This War of Mine: The Board Game rulebook (2nd edition, Awaken Realms, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Board in the middle of the table
Events deck, unseen, from the bottom: 3 shuffled Ending Events, Chapter III, 4 random Events, Chapter II, 3 random Events, Chapter I on top
steps.note: Unused Event cards go in the Waste bag

steps.text: Locations: 3 cards on Far, Distant and Close at random; the rest shuffled on the Locations space
Residents and Night Raids: set aside the 5 red-corner (!) cards of each; shuffle the rest onto their spaces
Shuffle Exploration, Findings, Visitors, Characters, Fate, Narrative Actions and Colors decks onto their spaces
Objectives deck: all Chapter Objectives and the Final Objective (Chapter I sorts them)
Green-corner Fittings on the Fittings space; orange-corner ones as the Ideas deck
The 19 Shelter cards, blue-corner side down and unseen, each on its matching Shelter space
Combat dice, black die and Noise marker near the board; tokens and resources in their box compartments
On Storage: Lockpick, Shovel, 3 Raw Food, 4 Components, 4 Wood, 2 Water
From the Character deck keep the first red-bordered and the first 2 black-bordered cards
Write their names on the Save Sheet
Their figures (each in a coloured disk) on the Guard space; matching colour token by each card
A Hunger 2 token by each Character
Shuffle the other Character cards onto the Characters space
Never read a script in the Book of Scripts until the game sends you there
The Leader has the final word, after hearing everyone
Characters belong to nobody: the group runs them together
Pick a random Leader; they take the first player token. Begin with the Morning phase
